title: Nahash besieges Jabesh and Saul's first victory
description: The Ammonites under Nahash besiege Jabesh in Gilead and demand a cruel treaty. When Saul hears about it, the Spirit of God comes upon him. He gathers Israel by sending pieces of ox as a warning, musters the army at Bezek, crushes the Ammonites, and saves the city. Then the people gather at Gilgal, where Saul is crowned king with peace offerings and great joy.
